title: The Debt of the DMZ
author: Elodie Sterling
blurb: Silas Okafor, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, works cases no one wants attributed. But when every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must burn the network that did the training before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
